legend.BUY_NO: executes at no_ask (NEVER 1 - yes_ask, which is the NO bid). The NO ask is the YES bid book (no_ask == 1 - yes_bid), so the size available is yes_bid_size; fee per contract is buy_no_fee. Kalshi publishes no_ask_size / no_bid_size as null.
legend.BUY_YES: executes at yes_ask; size offered is yes_ask_size; fee per contract is buy_yes_fee.
legend.book_state: two_sided | bid_only | ask_only | empty_book | no_quote. Read before any price.
legend.buy_yes_executable / buy_no_executable: true only when that side has positive quoted size. A price with zero size (e.g. the $0.00/$1.00 empty book) is not an offer.
legend.buy_yes_fee / buy_no_fee: Kalshi model TRADE fee per contract at that side's ask, rounded up to $0.000001. Not a net fee. null = unknown cost, never free (see fee_support when present).
legend.floor_strike: points (not money). Kalshi encodes '3+' as floor_strike 2.5.
legend.prices: dollars per $1 contract; a $1 binary's price is its implied probability.
legend.status: active = tradeable; finalized/determined = settled or settling; initialized = not yet open.
legend.title: what YES means, in Kalshi's words. Settlement text (rules_primary, rules_secondary, settlement_sources), the full fee block and mechanics are in event_files[event_ticker].
legend.updated_time: when Kalshi last changed this contract. Compute quote age against your own clock.
